settingsPages.emailNotSentYet: The email could not be sent yet. Try again later.
settingsPages.feedbackMessageHelp: At least 10 characters. We read every message.
settingsPages.approvalsDescription: Decide who signs off bills, purchase orders, expense claims and journals, by amount. The person who prepared a document can never approve it.
settingsPages.approvalsReadOnly: Only an owner or admin can change approval rules.
settingsPages.approvalsDocHelp_bill: A bill in a band below waits for its approver before it posts to the books.
settingsPages.approvalsDocHelp_purchase_: A purchase order in a band below waits for its approver before it can be sent.
settingsPages.approvalsDocHelp_expense_c: A claim in a band below waits for its approver before it can be paid.
settingsPages.approvalsJournalHelp: A manual journal above this amount is saved as a draft and posts only when a second person approves it.
settingsPages.approvalsNoRules: No rules: anyone allowed to approve can approve any amount, but never their own document.
settingsPages.approvalsMaxBelowMin: The upper amount must be at least the lower amount.
settingsPages.approvalsSelfHelp: While you are the only member, you may approve your own documents. As soon as you invite someone, a second person is required.
settingsPages.approvalsSelfLabel: Allow self-approval while I am the only member
settingsPages.numberingDescription: How invoices, cash sales, credit notes, debit notes and quotes are numbered. Cash sales have their own series, separate from tax invoices. Numbers stay in order with no gaps, as the FTA requires.
settingsPages.numberingReadOnly: Only an owner or admin can change numbering.
settingsPages.numberingLastIssued: Last issued: {last}. The next number can only move forward.
settingsPages.numberingBelowIssued: The next number must be above {last}, the last number issued.
settingsPages.numberingFtaNote: Changing the prefix or digits only changes how new numbers are written; numbers already issued never change.
settingsPages.taxRates.title: Tax rates
settingsPages.taxRates.description: Each VAT treatment, its rate and the VAT 201 boxes it feeds, read from the same engine that prepares your return.
settingsPages.taxRates.readOnly: Read only. Rates follow the law and are not edited here.
settingsPages.taxRates.emirateNote: Standard-rated sales go to the Box 1 row of your emirate, {emirate}.
settingsPages.taxRates.emirateMissing: Set your emirate in company settings: standard-rated sales are reported by emirate. Dubai is shown until then.
settingsPages.taxRates.loadFailed: Could not load the tax rates.
